objective: Close the M08 local-Vision burst and resource-pressure gate by proving concurrent explicit analyses remain serialized, every transient scheduler lease is released exactly once, and scheduler admission or lease-expiry failures become a stable retryable Vision capacity error without invoking Ollama or falling back to CPU.
non_goals: Do not run a real Vision model, Cloud request, GPU benchmark, desktop capture, repeated workflow or soak test.
Do not change scheduler priority, the 15.5 GiB admission ceiling, model selection, quantization, context length or VRAM reservations.
Do not add CPU fallback, parallel local inference, automatic capture, persistence or another dependency.
Do not change owner force-load behavior or the shared resource scheduler implementation.
Do not open M09 or claim the owner scene-QA accuracy/diversity gate.
contracts: At most one local Ollama /api/chat request is active per provider even when 32 owner-confirmed analyses arrive concurrently.
Every successful transient local analysis owns exactly one scheduler lease and releases it exactly once after success or failure.
Scheduler E_RESOURCE_CAPACITY and E_RESOURCE_LEASE_EXPIRED failures are exposed as retryable E_PERCEPTION_VISION_CAPACITY.
A scheduler denial before inference sends no /api/chat request and cannot trigger CPU inference.
The existing operator-pinned lease, Cloud provider behavior, bounded recovery and unload synchronization remain unchanged.
The burst test retains no image, model, GPU, audio or benchmark artifact.
allowed_dependencies: Python standard library and existing repository test tooling.
acceptance_criteria: A deterministic 32-request local burst test reports peak active /api/chat concurrency of exactly one and 32 successful results.
The burst test observes exactly 32 transient leases, each asserted active and released exactly once.
Capacity-denial and lease-expiry tests receive retryable E_PERCEPTION_VISION_CAPACITY and observe zero /api/chat calls.
All perception worker tests and repository fast tests pass.
Module-brief validation, GitNexus change scan and git diff check pass.
required_test_commands: uv run --frozen python -c "import json; from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator; schema=json.load(open('docs/schemas/module-brief.schema.json', encoding='utf-8')); brief=json.load(open('docs/modules/M08-S30-vlm-burst-resource-pressure-module-brief.json', encoding='utf-8')); Draft202012Validator(schema).validate(brief)"
uv run --frozen python -m unittest discover -s workers/perception/tests -p "test_*.py"
